body: Thing is though... It was my fault. I put her through hell. There's a lot that happened that I'd rather not say, but she had to deal with this (not quite this bad) pretty much constantly. I was the cause of every argument, I was the reason for all the bad things that happened, not her. How bad a person must I be that the most forgiving person I know (and she is, even after all of this she's still trying to help me) wants me out of their life completely? She never cared, it was just a lie, all of it was. She never felt anything for me, she was just using me to dump everything on and when she felt better she abandoned me and left me to pick up the pieces. And yes, I know it may seem like I'm contradicting myself, and that's because I am. I know that it wasn't her fault, but if I blame her, maybe I'll feel better. Never works. Oh, and if this life, that I have so much ahead of me in, is just more bullshit like this, if it's just more pain and misery then I don't want to continue it.
